title: UI perf: Windows RTX 4090 smoothness v1
problem: Keep Windows RTX 4090 UI smoothness as a sustainable performance contract: daily smoke, resize, and editor-resize gates must stay explainable and reversible, while the broad ui-gallery-steady surface is treated as maintenance/evidence-only until it is narrowed into smaller steady-contract groups.

repro.summary: Use the broad ui-gallery-steady maintenance run for tail evidence, then validate the resize, editor-resize, code-editor paint-tail, row-scoped content-resolve/touch, and split overlay single-script contracts with their dedicated gates.

continue_policy.notes: Keep the lane active for Windows smoothness maintenance. Do not re-promote broad ui-gallery-steady from the evidence-only maintenance boundary until the membership is narrowed into smaller steady-contract groups. ui-gallery-context-menu-right-click-steady, ui-gallery-dialog-escape-focus-restore-steady, ui-gallery-dropdown-open-select-steady, ui-gallery-code-editor-torture-autoscroll-steady, ui-gallery-code-editor-torture-autoscroll-typical, ui-gallery-overlay-pointer-move-steady, and ui-gallery-overlay-torture-steady now each have checked-in baselines; keep ui-gallery-overlay-steady evidence-only because the broad suite still mixes overlay, modal, and inspector members. The normalized ui-gallery-complex-steady run with --prelude-each-run now serves as the current paint exemplar, while the no-prelude underflow remains normalization-noise evidence only. The current code-editor renderer follow-on has moved stable glyph atlas lookup out of scene encode with a TextShape render-glyph cache, added the translation+uniform-scale glyph transform fast path, and moved text rendering to instanced glyph draws. A follow-up showed row-scene replay already hits almost all visible rows on steady autoscroll, and the old text glyph bucket was mostly per-glyph diagnostic timing; default renderer family profiling is now low-overhead, while detailed glyph emit timing requires FRET_DIAG_RENDERER_TEXT_GLYPH_EMIT_PROFILE=1. The repeat=7 code-editor steady gate passes the v2 baseline on the local Windows RTX 4090 run with low-overhead renderer family profiling, and the dedicated autoscroll typical gate uses UI-only frame_p95 thresholds with --perf-threshold-agg p90; next renderer work should only promote row/fragment replay from fresh low-overhead evidence. The 2026-05-11 content-resolve split showed RowGeomKey/RowSceneKey construction and row-rich cache comparison are negligible; if this lane continues with row-scoped replay work, target replay/touch mechanics and text draw from fresh low-overhead evidence. The 2026-05-11 hosted-resource touch precompute moved the row-scene touch scan off the hot path; official hosted-resources reruns now point at renderer-tail noise, not row-key design: rerun4/rerun5 kept record_passes at 31/44us max, while rerun6 had one isolated 123us record_passes outlier with stable renderer bytes, encode ops, and draw footprint. The dedicated trace and layout-node profile follow-ups are now captured as evidence for that verdict, and `diag triage` now emits `phase.timeline_hotspots` to tie phase timing to hotspot examples in one place. Treat this as jitter unless a fresh low-overhead pass-kind probe shows repeatable structural cost, and do not spend more time splitting RowGeomKey / RowSceneKey. The scratch element-children pool now exports grow events through UiDebugFrameStats, ElementDiagnosticsSnapshotV1, diag stats, and memory_summary; bundle parsing is covered by a fret-diag unit test.
